findings.problem: The hint rules out einzig and erst, but bloß is a common everyday synonym for merely or just, so it would also be a right answer.
findings.fix: hint: merely, just (the everyday word, not bloß, einzig or erst)

back.target: only, just, merely (adverb limiting an amount or scope)
back.example: I've only got ten euros on me.

note: Lediglich also means merely, but it's formal, so a beginner is unlikely to give it as the answer.
